characters.name: Bessie Higgenbottom
characters.description: Afraid of Needles: She is so afraid of them she runs away from the doctors when she has to get her booster shot. Art Evolution: Her pale skin and her dirty blonde hair from season one changes into her tan skin and orange hair from season two. Break the Cutie: In "Portrait of a Happy" when Fritz, a local photographer, refuses to take pictures of her dog Happy. Butt-Monkey: The show'sTerrible Trio(Portia, Gwen andPenny) seem to enjoy seeing her suffer. Catchphrase: "Awwwwwsome!"

characters.name: Happy Higgenbottom
characters.description: Afraid of Doctors: Happy had to be dragged by Bessie to go to the doctor. Alliterative Name:HappyHiggenbottom Badass Adorable: Happy is a little blue dog with one of his ears torn in half. Normally, he's loves to laze around, but when push comes to shove, he's got Bessie's back, and he can beverydangerous when pressed. Ear Notch: Part of his right ear is torn off. Fur Is Clothing: In the episode "B-Chip," Bessie asks a brainwashed Happy if he wants a booster shot. Cue him standing up and pulling down the lower half of his fur like pants giving us a closeup of his butt and his heart tattoo with the name "Jessica" on the right cheek.

characters.name: Ben Higgenbottom
characters.description: The Baby of the Bunch: Of the kids in the show, he's the youngest among the main cast. Big Fun: Seeing how he is a little obese. Compressed Vice: InBen Appetit, Ben is afraid of food touching each other due to Bessiemashing his food together and forcing it into his mouth when they were young. However, this fear (or even getting over it) has never been shown or referenced before or after this episode as Ben usually eats food without concern of it touching other food. Disappeared Dad: No mention of either Bessie and Ben's father has been made. Expy: Much like Bessie is modeled after her character Stacy, Ben is a based on Andy Richter from Late Night with Conan O'Brien.

characters.name: Hilary Higgenbottom
characters.description: Alliterative Name: Her name beingHilary andHiggenbottom. Beauty Equals Goodness: She's aBig Beautiful Womanand one of the nicer cast members. Big Beautiful Woman: From what we can see, she's plump and curvaceous. Big Fun: She's plump and fun-loving. Good Parents: She takes good care of both Bessie and Ben, even ifshe can get annoyed with Bessie.

characters.name: Portia Gibbons
characters.description: Alpha Bitch: A stuck-up, blonde,Valley Girl. Her cousin and mother are even worse. Beauty, Brains, and Brawn: She tends to play the beauty to Gwen's brains and Penny's brawn. Beauty Is Bad: Contrasting the homelier characters like Bessie and Penny, she's cute albeit with a terrible personality. Beta Bitch: While she's used to bossing Bessie, Gwen, and Penny around, she's contrastingly more submissive to Chelsea. Big Bad: For all intents and purposes, she's the show's principle antagonist, always trying to scheme against Bessie. Though sometimes she forages intoBig Bad Wannabeterritory instead.

characters.name: Gwen Wu
characters.description: Asian Rudeness: She's Portia's sidekick and is Chinese. Ambiguously Related: So far, the only other character with the surname of "Wu" is Mr. Wu and it's not clear if these two are related or not. Beauty, Brains, and Brawn: She plays much of the brains to Portia's beauty and Penny's brawn. Beauty Is Bad: With Portia as she's on the cuter side, but still enjoys bullying. Beta Bitch: Portia's right hand girl, along with serving asher dragon.

characters.name: Penny Lefkowitz
characters.description: Beauty, Brains, and Brawn: BeingDumb Muscle, she plays brawn to Portia's beauty and Gwen's brains. Beta Bitch: Much like Gwen, she tends to go along with whatever Portia has in mind, albeit to a lesser extent. Big Eater: Tying intoExtreme Omnivore, considering what she'll eat. She eats more taffy than she sells. Blonde, Brunette, Redhead: The brunette to Portia's blonde and Mary Frances' redhead (One of two). Cargo Ship: In-universe: Fell in love with a robotic kangaroo.

characters.name: Mrs. Gibbons
characters.description: Portia's mom, who's the den-mother of the Honeybees. According to her, the Honeybees are a "mother-daughter activity". Apathetic Teacher: She hates her job as scoutmaster as much as she hatesBessie, especially when Bessie outshines her daughter. Big Eater: She mentions that she eats at least two boxes of Honeybee taffy every day, then quickly claims it’s more one and a half when Bessie gets weirded out. Bland-Name Product: She's a certified representative of "Pattie Faye", a Mary Kay parody. Blonde, Brunette, Redhead: The redhead to Portia's blonde and Gwen and Penny's brunettes.

characters.name: Millie Millerson
characters.description: An odd little girl who's monotone and has braces Alliterative Name:MillieMillerson Ascended Extra: The makers of the show loved her voice so much they decided to make her more than just a background character. Braces of Orthodontic Overkill: Downplayed, as she had regular braces. She used to have braces throughout the show, but in the episode "Children of the Unicorn", her braces were removed. A Day in the Limelight: "Mr. Turtleton's Wild Ride", the episode concerning her trying to get the titular turtle back.

characters.name: Miriam Breedlove
characters.description: The president of the Honeybees. Big Beautiful Woman: To contrastPortiaand her group's more traditional beauty with theirBeauty Is Badportrayal, Miriam is a lot larger in frame, but still portrayed as an ideal to look up to. Big Good: As the president of the Honeybees, she serves as the main reason Bessie and the others are even together and striving towards their goals. Excellent Judge of Character: One of the major signs she's good at reading people is how in "To Bee or Not To Bee" she immediately rejectsPortia'scontest submission tape as soon as it's about to brag about the contents of her closet, while she watches Bessie's earnest submission tape the whole way through and selects her as winner. Nice Girl: She's shown to be very understanding and kind, even willing to put up with Bessie's odd antics and hear her out.

characters.name: Other Characters
characters.description: Evil Counterpart: Finguere, Finger's French cousin (really Bessie's right index finger) who encourages Bessie to act selfishly. Imaginary Friend: Though, he acts a lot less imaginary than the usual, complete with making his own expressions. The judge of whatever competition in town Demoted to Extra: He's only had two speaking roles in Season 2 Gonk: Not as much as Penny, but he's weird-looking.
